scope: Mathematical parameter symbols and result-specific hover definitions; no approximation, round-complexity or dominance changes.

displayPolicy.namedBounds: Always show mathematical symbols, independently of whether they occurred earlier in a row. Keep introduction metadata separate.
displayPolicy.sourceExpansionFunctions: Use an unspecified outer F when a source parameter is f or f(k), avoiding f(r,f).
displayPolicy.definitions: Context belongs to the result: d, g, f, W and other reused symbols retain their own source meaning.
displayPolicy.density: Preserve the supplied integer c≥∇₁(G); do not equate it to fractional density.
displayPolicy.accessibility: Hover, keyboard focus and touch expose the same definitions; enriched formulas retain their mathematical labels and use informational term targets.
displayPolicy.sources: Original formula strings, raw source fields and exact reduction substitutions remain available. CSV includes definitions; descriptive-name search remains supported.

sourceChecks.claim: The source expansion function g is distinct from genus or odd girth; f and b denote vertex capacities in their respective matching problems.

c is a supplied integer density bound; ∇₁(G) is the exact depth-one minor density.

derivedInstances: Target communication-graph variables n,m,Δ and line-graph variables Δ_L,m_L have explicit instance meanings; recipe T and α describe the algorithm used on the transformed instance.
